description: Rubash source pin for native-shell releases (rubash#827, conclusion B). Every release job fetches exactly this rubash commit into ../rubash -- where the [patch] path override in Cargo.toml deterministically picks it up -- and fails the release unless the checked-out HEAD equals rubash_rev. The compiled engine is pinned to an exact commit instead of being 'whatever rubash master HEAD was at build time'.
notes: Recorded from rubash master HEAD d75cc150773ae0e961868eb0a409d7d954c4cd65 (2026-10-21, Cargo.toml version 1.4.2) — the bash 5.3.20 version bump (rubash#978); supersedes a83a09d3 (1.4.1) because CI clones rubash master and a --locked build cannot span two engine versions.
NOTE: the rev includes #863 — rubash's own Cargo.lock self-entry must be 1.4.1 or the release build's --locked cargo calls (bash shim) fail inside the pinned clone.
Bumping the pin is a deliberate release decision: update rubash_rev and rubash_version together.
